What are the ingredients of som tam?

items.markdown:
![Ingredients Traditional Thai Salad Green Papaya Stock Photo ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280236-1672-0139-0000-33d8f96d80e9:6)
Som tam requires `shredded green papaya, Thai bird's-eye chilies, and garlic` as its core base.[[1]](https://hungryinthailand.com/som-tum-thai/)

Main Salad Ingredients

- **Green papaya:** 1.5 to 2 cups of peeled and shredded unripe green papaya
- **Cherry tomatoes:** 4 to 5 cherry tomatoes, halved
- **Yardlong beans:** 2 to 3 long beans, cut into 1-inch pieces
- **Roasted peanuts:** 2 tablespoons of coarsely chopped roasted peanuts
- **Dried shrimp:** 1 to 2 tablespoons of small dried shrimp
- **Carrot:** Optional shredded carrot for extra color[](https://www.maangchi.com/recipe/som-tam) [[1]](https://www.maangchi.com/recipe/som-tam)[[2]](https://www.seriouseats.com/som-tam-green-papaya-salad-5208332)[[3]](https://coleycooks.com/thai-green-papaya-salad/)[[4]](https://inquiringchef.com/green-papaya-salad-som-tam/)[[5]](https://rosasthai.com/recipes/papaya-salad)

Dressing Ingredients

- **Garlic:** 2 to 3 small cloves
- **Thai bird's-eye chilies:** 1 to 4 chilies adjusted to preferred heat
- **Fish sauce:** 2 to 3 tablespoons
- **Fresh lime juice:** 2 to 3 tablespoons
- **Palm sugar:** 1 to 1.5 tablespoons, softened or liquid
- **Tamarind juice:** 1 tablespoon optional for a smoother sour profile[](https://www.seriouseats.com/som-tam-green-papaya-salad-5208332) [[1]](https://www.vegrecipesofindia.com/thai-green-papaya-salad/)[[2]](https://www.foodandwine.com/som-tam-thai-style-green-papaya-salad-7503164)[[3]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/papaya-salad-v3/)

For tips on how to get the pounding technique and flavor balance just right:![Related video thumbnail](https://encrypted-tbn1.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSOe8Jtbkq1H_FNiehiZx_MhQj5PcBkYS-VxsbH3aFuLieaBg3l)
